newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN HAMON FAILED TO INFORM ON JOB CUTS - UNIONS.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN HAMON FAILED TO INFORM ON JOB CUTS - UNIONS.

text.p: Belgian cooling tower maker Hamon, which lists 325,000 shares on the Brussels bourse next week, has failed to inform personnel properly on planned job cuts, trade unions said on Friday.

"Management could not find a few hours to hold an extraordinary works council as foreseen under the law," unions said in a joint statement. "The Hamon Group enters the Brussels bourse, while 17 people could leave through the back door."
It said unions had lodged a complaint with the inspection service of the economics ministry about the lack of consultation over the job cuts.
"The concertation procedure has been dodged," it said.
